description.value: A farm-to-table restaurant in Revelstoke drawing directly from Terra Firma Farms, a certified organic operation just 5 km away that specializes in heirloom vegetables delivered almost daily. The kitchen mills its own flour for naturally leavened sourdough baked fresh each day, with a full bakery counter selling muffins, scones, brioches, and whole loaves — handy for cyclists looking to stock up. Breakfast and lunch menus celebrate seasonal, local ingredients with an uncompromising commitment to sourcing from nearby like-minded farms.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a real, operating farm-to-table restaurant in Revelstoke, BC, with active online ordering and a bakery. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via 'Order for Pickup - For Takeout Only' and the 15-minute ready guarantee. However, the business appears to have rebranded from 'Terra Firma's Kitchen' to 'Terravita Kitchen' — the page title, footer copyright ('2020–2026 Terravita Kitchen'), and catering email (kitchen@terravitakitchen.ca) all use the new name, while the domain and OSM name still reflect the old one; no bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Business appears to have rebranded to 'Terravita Kitchen' — page title, footer copyright ('2020–2026 Terravita Kitchen'), and catering contact email (kitchen@terravitakitchen.ca) all use the new name, while the OSM record and domain still reflect 'Terra Firma's Kitchen'. enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant in Revelstoke confirmed by an active website with online ordering; takeout and fresh baked goods make it useful to touring cyclists.
